messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: service=inference-eu-errors (P2)
incident-bot: Trigger condition: 5xx rate > 12% over 2m on route /v1/generate, region=eu-central-1, recent spike in KV cache misses. PagerDuty incident: https://pd.example/INC12345
alice.w: I'm on call, grabbing it now :eyes:
marcos: Noticed increased 5xx and some 504s around 12:10. Dashboards show a sudden drop in available GPUs for dedicated pool eu-1.
alice.w: Checking autoscaler and pool health. Running quick check...
alice.w: ```
# check pool
rctl pool status dedicated-eu-1
kubectl logs deploy/infer-runtime -n infra-eu --tail 200 | grep -i "evict"
``` 
marcos: KV cache evictions high. Might be eviction storm from long seqs. Trying to disable aggressive eviction for now.
laura: I'm taking customer comms for EU customers, will post ETA when we have mitigation.
sre-lead: If we can scale ephemeral workers we should, else fallback to smaller model variant.
alice.w: Initiating scale up: `rctl scale pool dedicated-eu-1 --replicas=4` and enabling burst-capacity for 10m
cs-oncall: CS: we already got two customer tickets reporting "generation failed", both EU-based. I'm passing updates.
marcos: Patch applied to eviction policy, monitoring for drop in errors. Adding a quick rate-limit fallback for heavy clients.
alice.w: Error rate trending down from 14% -> 3% in last 2m. Will keep monitoring, planning handoff to laura in 15m for follow-up and postmortem
laura: Ack, I'll take the rest. Can someone add this to incident tracker INC12345 and tag SRE oncall?
ops: Added incident and created postmortem placeholder: https://jira.example/browse/INC12345
incident-bot: Page acknowledged by alice.w at 3481234570
incident-bot: Page resolved (auto) at 3481234622 — mitigation successful, error rate within SLO. Reminder: runbook link https://runbooks.example/inference/kv-eviction
laura: Thanks all, I'll lead the follow-up, schedule postmortem notes and customer summary.
